model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the evolution of loss over the number of iterations for five different models or configurations. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140,000 iterations, with tick marks appearing at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", uses a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks appearing at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains five distinct lines, each representing a different model variant: a purple line labeled "Vanilla", a blue line labeled "SturmLLM (n=64)", an orange line labeled "SepLLM (n=64)", a green line labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H)", and a red line labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)". A fifth line, labeled "SepLLM (n=128)", is depicted in dark blue. All lines start at a high loss value near 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a downward trend, converging to a lower loss value near 2.5 as iterations increase to 140,000. The "Vanilla" model (purple) begins at approximately 3.4 and decreases to around 2.5. The "SturmLLM (n=64)" model (blue) begins at approximately 3.3 and decreases to around 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64)" model (orange) begins at approximately 3.3 and decreases to around 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" model (green) begins at approximately 3.3 and decreases to around 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" model (red) begins at approximately 3.3 and decreases to around 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=128)" model (dark blue) begins at approximately 3.4 and decreases to around 2.5. All lines are solid with no markers, and the lines are closely grouped, indicating similar performance trends.
